Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Subject: Acme onsite workshop - dinner & event logistics (Mar 18)

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for confirming the Mar 18 onsite workshop at Acme HQ. We're finalizing the evening logistics and want to make this as seamless as possible for your execs and the broader team. Quick list of asks so we can lock vendors/rooms this week: 

1) Final headcount (estimate is fine) + dietary restrictions by Tue, Mar 10.
2) Any executive preferences (private table/quiet seating / early seating)? You mentioned 2–3 folks might want a private table — can you name them?
3) Budget target per head for dinner (so we can pick plated vs buffet).
4) AV / tech or meal-timing preferences (do you want dinner before or after the final breakout?)

We’ve provisionally scoped two options: private dining at the Downtown Hotel (plated 3-course) or a hosted cocktail + stations at the adjacent event hall. I’ve attached a draft timeline and notes for venue access. Dev and Neha are cc’d to coordinate menu and room layout.

Attachments: draft_event_timeline.pdf

If it helps, we can also introduce the hotel events manager and the catering lead directly — saves back-and-forth.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Hi Marissa —

Thanks — here are the initial details from our side: 
- Headcount: 24 confirmed (including 3 execs).
- Dietary: 4 vegetarian, 2 pescatarian, 1 gluten-free, 2 with nut allergies.
- Exec preferences: CEO (A. Martinez) and VP Eng (R. Patel) would prefer a private table; CTO prefers to sit with product team.
- Budget: we'd like to keep dinner under $120/person if possible (including tax/gratuity).

I've cc’d Tom (internal events) and BluePlate who manage catering for our HQ events. Tom — BluePlate is familiar with our dietary needs and venue constraints; can you share sample menus and confirm if private dining is available on Mar 18 evening?

Also: PO will be required for payment; procurement lead will need an invoice.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Sarah Lopez
Head of Product Programs, Acme Corp
sarah.lopez@acme.com | +1 (718) 555-3390

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Acme menu options and logistics

Marissa / Neha —

Following Sarah's note, I spoke to BluePlate and pulled together three menu options that meet the dietary constraints and the $120/head cap if we go plated (lean menu). Attached: dinner_menu_options.xlsx and venue_floorplan.png. High level: 

- Option A (Plated, lean): 3-course plated with vegetarian and pescatarian mains, dedicated gluten-free plating; estimated $105/person.
- Option B (Stations): 5 stations including two vegetarian stations, higher throughput but less formal — $95/person plus higher gratuity.
- Option C (Plated premium): upgraded protein options for execs/private table; $140/person (exceeds stated budget).

Logistics notes: Downtown Hotel private dining requires final guest list and AV specs by Mar 10 to confirm room and menu. They can do a private table for up to 6 at the head of the room. Catering can do separate allergy-safe plating for the two nut-allergy guests.

Recommend Option A with an exec upgrade add-on for the three execs if Acme agrees. I can pull exact menu line items if preferred.

Attachments: dinner_menu_options.xlsx, venue_floorplan.png

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer (Events)
Redwood Inference

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick responses. Based on the budget and dietary constraints, Redwood recommends Option A (3-course plated, lean) + exec upgrade for the CEO and VP Eng (private table and upgraded entrée). Outline below: 

- Venue: Downtown Hotel, Private Dining Room B (reserved 6:00–10:30pm)
- Arrival / Cocktail: 6:00–7:00pm (stationed appetizers & bar)
- Seated Dinner: 7:00pm (3-course plated; vegetarian/pescatarian/gluten-free special plates)
- Estimated headcount: 24 (final list due Mar 10)
- Execs: Private table for CEO, VP Eng (req'd: two name placards)
- Catering notes: allergy-safe plating, separate plating for nut allergies, gluten-free bread alternative
- AV: table mics not required; projector/screen for one short 5–10min CEO welcome during dessert — will need HDMI + laptop adapter (Redwood to bring).
- Billing: Acme procurement requires invoice + PO (Sarah — can you share PO number when available?).

I've attached the updated site map for ingress/egress and a short logistics checklist for closer-in tasks (final guest list, place cards, dietary confirmations). Please confirm and I'll lock the hotel and catering.

Attachments: site_map.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to this. If Sarah confirms PO/budget we will issue a vendor hold today.

Best,
Marissa Cole
